audits.resolution_reason: Ordinary first lesson admits first-two-emitter rival on all three demos and contradicts it only on query; source-bound production census and four Racket outputs retained.
audits.text:
## 510b12f6a12a

**Reproduced teaching defect: the ordinary first lesson hides an extra-emitter
shortcut until its query.**

Generator version 3.0.0, SHA-256:
6b6c2d8c633f257d81cd33d08012ca9ef4004c72c88147a9db0a4d422c965540.
Canonical program text SHA-256: b21aac78c1da3a66bd566c7a095fb91cdc6f00134cec7a39064e272cf664890f.
Declared and executed rule hash: 8686bcf8a89a.

The generator's first three easy profiles each have exactly two emitters on each
edge. The fourth profile has four vertical emitters. Its declared
first_two_emitters_only rival therefore fits all three demonstrations but misses
query intersections. This is an ordinary unpinned three-demonstration/one-query
lesson, not an invalid-grid or wrong-reference-label finding.

The exact seed 0, sample-index0..3 inputs are in input.json under this audit folder.
All four pass self_check. Public arcpuzzles apply returned valid outputs for all
four: rival agreement is [true,true,true,false]. The generated query is deliberately
required by the existing constructor to expose an extra-emitter effect.

The public production materializer independently reproduces the defect:
lesson-census, easy, one lesson, source-bound seed 3866933590, start 0, three demos
and one query. It reports 1/1 production lessons ambiguous and 1/4 query rotations
ambiguous, with zero materialization/scoring errors or warnings. The final
command exits 1 because it measured ambiguity; this is expected finding evidence,
not an unfinished main-generator check. Exact accepted indices and the whole
labeled episode are in checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/lesson-census.json.

The previous task-local workspace/lesson_probe.py explains its overly reassuring
claim: its scoring loop iterates all four labeled pairs in each lesson, including
the query. A rival differing only on that query is consequently counted as
refuted. Correct lesson evidence must check demonstration survival first and
then compare the query; query disagreement is not a demonstration.

Suggested repair: move sufficient extra-emitter witnesses into every supported
demonstration window, test all eight cyclic starts, and inspect every allowed
query rotation. Replace the old all-pairs scoring with the shared production
lesson census. This return does not patch the audit target.

Evidence:

- checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/input.json — exact four generated inputs.
- checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/racket-retry.json — successful public reference receipt.
- checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/counterexample.json — source/settings, actual/rival outputs.
- checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/lesson-census.json — production and rotation counterexample.
- checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/interrupted-apply/ — preserved earlier SIGKILL evidence;
  the successful retry supplies the measured outputs.

Reproduction from WORK:

    python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 510b12f6a12a --input ../checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/input.json --out ../checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/racket-replay.json
    python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles lesson-census 510b12f6a12a --per-band 1 --band easy --rotate-query --rotation-policy require --timeout 180 --out ../checks/audit/510b12f6a12a/lesson-replay.json

The target generator, rule, canonical data and tests are unchanged.
